subject: Security onboarding follow-up — SOC 2, GDPR & IR timelines for StellarQuest
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <security@stellarquest.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T15:12:00-05:00
Subject: Security onboarding follow-up — SOC 2, GDPR & IR timelines for StellarQuest

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap + asks so we can keep procurement moving on your end: 

Summary of what we covered
- Demo highlights: Redwood hosted API, Dedicated options, and private VPC deployment patterns.
- Focus area you flagged: incident response timelines, breach notification flow, and vendor evidence for SOC 2 / GDPR.

Action items / asks from StellarQuest (can you confirm):
1) SOC 2 report availability — do you need Type I or Type II? We have a Type II from March 2026 and can share the report and the auditor contact under NDA.
2) GDPR / DPA — we have a standard DPA; if StellarQuest requires specific clauses, please flag. Also note we support data residency controls.
3) HIPAA / BAA — is StellarQuest in-scope for PHI? If so, we can provide our BAA and security controls mapping.
4) Incident response & breach notification timeline — primary ask from your security team: what are expected notification SLAs, sample IR runbook, and evidence we can provide during a post-incident review (logs, chain-of-custody, forensics).
5) BCP/DR evidence — recovery time objectives, DR test cadence, and a high-level network diagram.

Can you confirm which of the above are required for your procurement packet and target dates for delivery? If OK, I’ll loop in our security engineer (Ben) and security ops (Marissa) to assemble the items and share through a secure Drive link.

Proposed timeline: we can drop a primary package (SOC 2 + pen test summary + IR runbook sample + network diagram) within 3 business days once we have a confirmed NDA / scope. Full responses to questionnaire within 7 business days.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Attachments: security-intake-questionnaire-link.txt (link to MCQ questionnaire)
From: Alex Kim <security@stellarquest.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding follow-up — SOC 2, GDPR & IR timelines for StellarQuest

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear summary. A couple clarifications so we can route internally: 
- We definitely need SOC 2 Type II and the last penetration test summary.
- GDPR is in scope; StellarQuest operates in the EU for part of our customer base. HIPAA is not in scope for this project (no PHI expected).
- Procurement wants a confirmed IR notification SLA: legal wants a 72-hour initial notification window and an escalation path. Can you confirm Redwood’s policy on notification timing and whether you provide an escalation roster?

We will start the vendor questionnaire on our side; please send the Drive link for uploads and a HubSpot deal ref if you have it so procurement can match documents. Also include the contact for your security lead for any follow-up.

I can commit to an internal deadline: questionnaire back to you by EOD 2026-12-10, with any follow-ups immediately after. If you could provision the SOC2/pen test by 2026-12-06 that would keep us on track.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Kim
Security Manager, StellarQuest
security@stellarquest.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <security@stellarquest.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T09:18:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding follow-up — SOC 2, GDPR & IR timelines for StellarQuest

Thanks Alex — looping in Ben (Security SE) and Marissa (Security ops / compliance) to own the artifacts and timeline.

Ben / Marissa — per Alex, priority is: SOC 2 Type II + pen test summary by 12/06, questionnaire returned by StellarQuest on 12/10, and IR notification SLA clarity (StellarQuest requests 72 hours).

Suggested MAP (mutual action plan):
- Today (12/04): Ben to share SOC 2 Type II report, pen test summary, IR runbook sample, and a high-level network diagram via Drive link + list of redacted logs we can provide.
- 12/06: Provide signed NDA if needed (procurement) and upload primary package to the Drive link.
- 12/10: Alex to return completed questionnaire.
- Week of 12/13: Optional 30-min security sync to review answers and any open controls.

Ben — can you attach the artifacts and call out any items that will take longer than 7 business days (e.g., raw log exports or long-retention artifacts)? Also list the escalation contacts and expected notification SLA we publish.

Jordan

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-12-04T11:42:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding follow-up — SOC 2, GDPR & IR timelines for StellarQuest

Alex / Jordan —

Summary of what we can provide immediately and expected delivery windows: 
1) SOC 2 Type II report (Auditor: Oakridge LLP) — final signed report from 2026-03-15. Available to share under NDA today. (attachment stub: SOC2_TypeII_Mar2026.pdf)
2) Penetration test summary — Redacted executive summary available (attachment stub: pen_test_summary_202605.docx). Full remediation evidence can be provided on request.
3) IR runbook sample — redacted runbook and a one-page timeline for breach notification (attachment stub: ir_runbook_sample.pdf).
4) Logs and retention — we retain access logs and audit trails for 365 days; forensic-grade raw logs can be exported but require a formal request and may take up to 10 business days depending on retention tier.
5) Notification SLA & escalation roster — our standard practice: initial notification within 48 hours of confirmed incident, with escalation to customer security lead and account exec if material. We can accept a 72-hour customer-window as a procurement negotiation point; any acceleration in notifications will be honored for confirmed incidents. Contact list: security-ops@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com (SE on-call), marissa_cole@redwood.com (compliance).
6) BCP/DR evidence — RTO targets and test cadence summary included in the package; full DR runbook can be shared under NDAs.
7) GDPR / DPA — we have a standard DPA with data processing addendum clauses; will attach.

Drive link (secure): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D5E (I’ll add the files tonight).
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/34567 (ref: SQ-2026-045)

Proposed quick sync: 2026-12-07 10:00am PT (30 mins) — I can walk through the artifacts and answer detailed questions. If that works for you, Alex, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments (stubs): SOC2_TypeII_Mar2026.pdf, pen_test_summary_202605.docx, ir_runbook_sample.pdf, network_diagram_v2.pdf

— Ben
Ben Carter
Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Ben / Jordan —

This all looks good. Confirming next steps from our side: 
- Procurement will sign the standard NDA today and we will upload the questionnaire answers to your Drive folder by EOD 2026-12-10.
- We will target the 12/07 10:00am PT sync — please send invite.
- StellarQuest legal notes the 72-hour initial notification request; we appreciate Redwood’s flexibility on the 48-hour standard. We will outline any required language for the contract if needed.

I’ll await the Drive files and the calendar invite. Thanks for the quick turnaround — it helps keep our procurement window tight.

Best — Alex
Alex Kim
Security Manager, StellarQuest
